name: K’gari
description: K'gari, off Queensland's east coast about 250 km north of Brisbane, is the world's largest sand island at 122 km long. Its name is Batjala for "paradise." Tall rainforest grows from pure sand here, and inland from the beach lie freshwater lakes perched in the dunes, making up half the world's examples. Shifting dunes, jungle and lakes all share one island.
